items.label: rAAV2 gene therapy × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Ph3 meta n=175: BCVA significantly improved, responder rate flat, mild AEs (42131170); preclinical ND6 positive (42709484); SOC idebenone nonsignificant (42535808).

items.label: Elamipretide × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Ph4 meta: accelerated approval, Barth muscle strength; cardiac unconfirmed (42794697); Ph3/Ph4 RCTs unposted (NCT05162768, NCT07531251); late-stage PMD class negatives (42361626); no disease-modifying standard (42229401).

items.label: Nicotinamide riboside (NAD+ precursor) × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Ph2 RCT: VO2 gain only with exercise (42009009); benefit variable (42489969); oral, mild AEs (42009009); supportive-care SOC only (42361626); small trial unposted (NCT07344636).

items.label: Mitochondria-targeted agents (class) × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Meta: LVEF SMD 0.42, mortality RR 0.62, HF admissions RR 0.60 (42440741); heterogeneous, no GDMT comparator (42495453); reviews only, no posted trials (40845481, 42022751).

items.label: Idebenone × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (single meta; total capped at 4): partial visual recovery, not significant (42535808); oral, safe CoQ10 analog; disease-modifying gap persists.

items.label: MitoQ × preeclampsia
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (single registry trial; capped at 4): Ph2 n=80, no results posted (NCT07229261); no disease-modifying prevention exists.

items.label: MitoQ × post-stroke
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (flagged): single Ph2 n=30, no posted results (NCT06930638); limited options to limit infarct expansion.

items.label: MitoQ × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Preclinical only: mouse DCM/infarct models, hemodynamics and mtROS significant (42432986, 42479041); no human HF trial in records (42495453); GDMT comparator absent.

leaders: rAAV2 gene therapy × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (7.2)
outsiders: MitoQ × chronic heart failure (3.2): preclinical-only animal models (42432986, 42479041); no active human HF trial (42495453).
MitoQ × post-stroke (3.6): single unreported Ph2 trial, zero posted outcomes (NCT06930638).
caveats: No record quantifies a standard-of-care comparator arm (supportive care, idebenone, GDMT); head-to-head SOC comparison impossible (42361626, 42440741, 42535808).
CHF meta pools heterogeneous agent classes; indirectness and likely small underlying trials (42440741, 42495453).
Elamipretide Ph3/Ph4 RCTs have no posted results; class-level late-stage PMD trials negative/inconclusive (NCT05162768, NCT07531251, 42361626) may lower effect_direction.
Peak VO2 is a surrogate outcome; NR efficacy contingent on exercise co-intervention (42009009).
Thin-evidence cap (total <= 4) applied to single-record directions (42535808, NCT07229261, NCT06930638).
Methodological record (single-cell omics, 40974057) excluded; non-top-8 directions omitted (MitoQ x COVID NCT05886816, urolithins 42773997/42713995, musculoskeletal 42727834, Restorin NR 42582917).
